title: Torah 3 phrase-by-phrase study guide
status: Editorial navigation aid — the sourced Hebrew and English remain unchanged

phrases.he: תא חזי כמה נפיש חיליה דאילנא
phrases.en: Come and see how great the strength of that tree is
phrases.enMatch: Come, see how great the strength of that tree is
phrases.info: The fantastic tale’s closing image becomes the lesson’s symbol for the protective power of kindness.

phrases.he: מי ששומע נגינה ממנגן רשע, קשה לו לעבודת הבורא
phrases.en: Hearing a wicked singer can hinder divine service
phrases.enMatch: when someone listens to the singing of a singer who is wicked, it is detrimental to his serving the Creator
phrases.info: The lesson opens by distinguishing the spiritual effects of music according to its singer’s character.

phrases.en: The voice of song is drawn from the birds
phrases.enMatch: the voice of song is drawn from the birds
phrases.info: Birds become the lesson’s image for the spiritual source from which melody is drawn.

phrases.he: לכך נקרא המנגן חזן, מלשון חזון
phrases.en: A singer is called chazan from chazon, prophecy
phrases.enMatch: This is why a singer is called a ChaZaN, from the word ChaZoN, which connotes prophecy
phrases.info: The wordplay links sacred song to vision and prophecy, whose source the worthy singer accesses.

phrases.he: המנגן הוא רשע, אזי הוא לוקח הנגינה שלו מצפרים אחרות שבקלפה
phrases.en: A wicked singer takes his song from the birds of the kelipah
phrases.enMatch: when a singer is wicked, he takes his song from other birds, [from] those of the kelipah
phrases.info: Corrupt song is traced to an opposing spiritual source, the birds associated with the kelipah.

phrases.en: Study the Oral Torah at night
phrases.enMatch: studying the Oral Torah at night
phrases.info: Nighttime study of Oral Torah is given as the remedy that permits hearing song without harm.

phrases.en: The Oral Torah is an aspect of night
phrases.enMatch: the Oral Torah is an aspect of night
phrases.info: The identification of Oral Torah with night grounds the remedy in rabbinic readings of darkness.

phrases.en: Rise, sing out in the night
phrases.enMatch: Rise, sing out in the night
phrases.info: The verse is read as teaching that night study raises and rectifies song.

phrases.he: חוט של חסד נמשך עליו ומגן עליו
phrases.en: A thread of lovingkindness is drawn over him and protects him
phrases.enMatch: a thread of lovingkindness is drawn over him <during the day> (Chagigah 12b), and it protects him
phrases.info: Night study draws a protective thread of kindness even when the learner’s intention is imperfect.

phrases.he: השתי צפרים חיות טהורות הם בנין המלכות דקדשה
phrases.en: The two live pure birds build Malkhut of Holiness
phrases.enMatch: these two live pure birds are the concept of building up Malkhut d’Kedushah
phrases.info: The holy birds are identified with the construction of sacred kingship, in contrast to the birds of the kelipah.
phrases.source: Writings of the Ari · Likutei Moharan 3:2:1

phrases.en: Song builds kingship
phrases.enMatch: song is the concept of building up Malkhut
phrases.info: David’s musical skill signals fitness for kingship because melody itself builds Malkhut.

phrases.en: Tzephardea is read as tzipor deah, a bird of knowledge
phrases.enMatch: tzephardeah —i.e., tzipor deah
phrases.info: The frog in Rabbah’s tale is reread through wordplay as the bird-intellect of the Other Side.
phrases.source: Rashbam on Bava Batra 73b · Likutei Moharan 3:3:2

phrases.en: Cry out from the throat
phrases.enMatch: cry out from the throat
phrases.info: Akra deHagrunia is linked phonetically to Isaiah’s command, locating song in the throat.

phrases.he: שתין בתי, הינו על־ידי שתין מסכתות
phrases.en: Sixty houses signify the sixty tractates
phrases.enMatch: the “sixty houses,” the sixty tractates [of the Talmud
phrases.info: The city’s sixty houses are interpreted as the Talmud’s tractates, through which the throat is rectified.

phrases.he: שילמד שלא לשמה, יבלע אותה הנחש
phrases.en: Study not for its own sake lets the serpent swallow it
phrases.enMatch: not for its own sake, and so the serpent <swallowed> it
phrases.info: The serpent swallowing the frog represents the danger in studying for the status of being called rabbi.
phrases.source: Rashbam on Bava Batra 73b · Likutei Moharan 3:3:5

phrases.en: Study at night, hinted by arvit
phrases.enMatch: One should study at night
phrases.info: The raven, orev, is associated with arvit and thus with the lesson’s remedy of nighttime study.
phrases.source: Rashbam on Bava Batra 73b · Likutei Moharan 3:3:6

phrases.en: It protects him from the serpent
phrases.enMatch: protected him from the above mentioned serpent
phrases.info: The raven swallowing the serpent signifies nighttime Torah study shielding the learner from corrupt intention.

phrases.he: החוט של חסד שנמשך עליו, מגן עליו מן הנחש
phrases.en: The thread of lovingkindness protects him from the serpent
phrases.enMatch: The thread of lovingkindness that is drawn over him protects him from the serpent
phrases.info: The tree is associated with Avraham’s kindness, making the thread of kindness the learner’s protection.

phrases.en: His lovingkindness toward us is overpowering
phrases.enMatch: God’s lovingkindness on our behalf is so overpowering
phrases.info: Rabbah’s amazement is explained as wonder at kindness strong enough to protect even flawed study.

phrases.he: עשה לך רב, וקנה לך חבר, והוי דן את כל האדם לכף זכות
phrases.en: Get a rabbi, acquire a companion, and judge everyone favorably
phrases.enMatch: Get yourself a rabbi, acquire for yourself a companion, and judge everyone favorably
phrases.info: The Mishnah’s three linked clauses are reread as a sequence joining kingship, voice, and favorable judgment.

phrases.en: He rectifies the building of his Malkhut
phrases.enMatch: rectifies the concept of building up Malkhut
phrases.info: Properly receiving song repairs the listener’s own aspect of sacred kingship.

phrases.he: קנה לך חבר, הינו על־ידי קנה, שהקול יוצא ממנו
phrases.en: Acquire a companion points to the windpipe from which voice emerges
phrases.enMatch: K’NeH (acquire) for yourself a companion.” That is, by means of the KaNeH (windpipe), via which the voice emerges
phrases.info: The word k’neh, acquire, is read as kaneh, windpipe, connecting companionship to the organ of voice.

phrases.he: שצריך לדון את כל אדם לכף זכות
phrases.en: One must judge every person favorably
phrases.enMatch: It is necessary to judge each person favorably
phrases.info: Because rectified Malkhut confers power, favorable judgment is required to prevent destructive use of it.

phrases.en: Malkhut of Holiness is now in exile
phrases.enMatch: Malkhut of Holiness is presently in exile
phrases.info: The exile of sacred kingship explains why song and the spiritual understanding of cantors are presently impaired.

phrases.en: Then song will be uplifted and perfected
phrases.enMatch: then song will be uplifted and perfected
phrases.info: Future restoration of sacred kingship will restore song to its source in holy intellect.

phrases.en: Sing with understanding
phrases.enMatch: zamru maskil (sing, O intelligent one
phrases.info: The psalm is read as a promise that singers will regain knowledge when Malkhut of Holiness rises.

phrases.he: על־ידי שלומד תורה בלילה, על־ידי־זה נתתקן הקול
phrases.en: Through studying Torah at night, the voice is rectified
phrases.enMatch: the thread of lovingkindness drawn over one who studies Torah at night—the voice is rectified
phrases.info: The addendum restates the chain: night study draws kindness, and kindness repairs the voice.

phrases.en: Prophecy is drawn from the cherubs
phrases.enMatch: prophecy is drawn from the cherubs
phrases.info: The cherubs correspond to the two holy birds and therefore connect prophecy with the building of kingship.

phrases.he: דוד המלך עליו השלום היה יכול לתקן ולהעלות גם הנגינה שאינו מאדם כשר
phrases.en: King David could rectify and uplift even an unworthy singer’s song
phrases.enMatch: King David had the ability to rectify and uplift even the song of someone who was not virtuous
phrases.info: David’s exceptional power reaches beyond holy melody and elevates song originating from an unworthy person.

phrases.en: Through this, Malkhut of Holiness ascended
phrases.enMatch: as a result, Malkhut of Holiness ascended
phrases.info: David’s rectification of song from behind holiness raises sacred kingship and explains his merit for kingship.
